yourNature_desc: You are the jewel a patient hand made small, holding more light than its size allows. You keep your best in reserve and bring it out when something counts. With your Metal even, you need to feel sure a thing deserves it first. Each day you choose between one piece made perfect and many finished well enough. You do that sorting on top of the work, and it tires you more than the making.

self_card.face: The stone, worn only when it matters
self_card.presence: You save your full care for what matters rather than spending it on everything. You weigh each thing all day, and you pay for that weighing in quiet tiredness.

_trace.yourNature_desc: Even Metal means the standard is held back until earned, so the reader needs proof a thing deserves it and pays in constant sorting.
_trace.self_card: care saved for what matters makes the sorting itself the price.
